messages: Hi! I'm Elizabeth! Welcome to Wildlife Explorer! 🌍
I'm doing my SATs this year too, so I know how it feels!
Pick a habitat, listen to the word, then type it. Easy!
I'll be here if you need me. Good luck, explorer!

returnVisit.message: Welcome back, explorer! Ready for more discoveries?
Hey! Great to see you again! Let's do some exploring!
You're back! I've been waiting — let's go!

returnVisitWithStreak.message: Your streak is going strong — let's keep it up! 🔥

quizWrongStreak.message: Hey, these are tricky ones! Want to hear the word again?
Don't worry — even I get stuck on these sometimes!
You're doing great — tricky words take practice!

quizFirstCorrect.message: Great start! You're going to love discovering the animal in this habitat!

quizStreak5.message: Five in a row! You're on fire! 🔥

quizStreak10.message: TEN in a row?! You're absolutely smashing it! ⭐

habitatComplete.message: You did it! How cool is that?!

sessionEnd.message: Amazing exploring today! Your brain needs a rest now — come back tomorrow!
Brilliant session! You've earned a break. See you next time!

home.message: Pick a habitat to start exploring! Each one has a hidden animal to find.

habitats.message: Choose a habitat — the progress bars show how far you've got in each one!

quiz.message: Listen to the word, then type it in the box. You can hear it again by pressing the speaker button.

collection.message: Here are all the animals you've discovered! Keep exploring to find more.

settings.message: You can change the font and colours here to make it easier to read.

diagnostic.message: This quiz helps me work out which habitats you'll enjoy the most. No pressure!

mockSats.message: This is like a real SATs spelling test — but just for practice. You've got this!

mathsDashboard.message: Welcome to Maths! Pick a topic to start learning. I'll help you along the way!

mathsDiagnostic.message: Let's see what you know about maths — no pressure, just a few quick questions!

mathsSession.message: Read the question carefully, and take your time. There's no rush!

mathsFirstVisit.message: Ooh, Maths! I love fractions — they're like puzzles! Let me show you around. Pick a topic to get started!

mathsWrongStreak.message: Fractions can be tricky! Remember — whatever you do to the bottom, do the same to the top!
Don't worry — even I had to practise these loads before they clicked!
You're doing great — maths is all about practice. Let's try another!

mathsTopicComplete.message: You've mastered this topic! That's amazing — I'm so proud of you! ⭐

mathsSessionEnd.message: Great maths session! Your brain has been working hard — have a rest!
Brilliant work with fractions! Come back soon for more practice!
